SourceString: Where natural resources are extracted and made ready for crafting.
Buildings where {P_C}professions{##} operate and {CHAR_CITVSWOR_C}workers{##} carry out their trade or activities.
Provides convenience and strategic advantages to its owner.
Structures maintained in the name of the city, supporting civic life and public functions.
Buildings intended for living, rest, and the daily life of a household or family.
A second roof to prove your first wasn't expensive enough.
Double-click the building to step inside
A source of precious ores and minerals, fueling the city's economy and craftsmanship.
A rugged site where slate, brick, and granite are extracted for construction and crafting projects.
The land's yield, gathered and ready for sale — waiting to be worked into something more.
A timber-rich area where wood is harvested to supply the city.
We turn curiosity into gold — sometimes literally.
We keep what others leave behind. Quiet work, steady hands, and no room for mistakes — once is enough.
Order does not keep itself. We train, we watch, and when needed, we act.
A place where professionals gather to train, share knowledge, and receive support.
A good drink, a warm bed, and the right rumor at the right time — this is our trade.
Measure twice, cut once. We shape wood, and the city rests on it.
Coin flows where we allow it. Debts are remembered, even when people hope they are not.
What cannot be seen can still command a room. We deal in scents — and the impressions they leave behind.
Words shape souls. Whether they listen is their concern — we make sure they hear.
The road belongs to those who can hold it. If it moves, we can take it.
Give us fire and iron — we will give you the tools to shape the world.
Stone remembers. We make sure it remembers us.
Cloth may cover the body — but we decide what it says.
You will not see us. You will notice what is missing.
Every deal has two sides. We make sure ours is better.
If they are watching, we are winning. If they are paying, even better.
There are no buildings for sale at the moment.
Where alchemy and craft meet to refine potions, remedies, and solutions for all needs.
A place of worship offering redemption, knowledge, and connection with the divine.
A lively camp where performers stage plays and sell mystical objects.
A peaceful burial ground, offering family graves for those wishing to honor their ancestors.
A training ground and residence for the guards, keeping order and protecting the people.
A warm establishment serving food, drinks, and games for both travelers and townsfolk.
Where skilled hands carve wood into toys, tools, and weapons alike.
Where masons craft stone into tools, treasures, and stronger structures for the city.
A trusted place for loans, currency exchange, and a variety of financial services.
A fragrant workshop where exotic oils and scents are blended into perfumes.
A fortified stronghold where robbers dominate the roads and control illicit profits.
A forge dedicated to creating tools, weapons, and fine jewelry.
Where wool and leather combine to create clothing for everyday wear or special occasions.
A secret refuge where thieves operate in the shadows, preying on the unwary.
A facility for storing trade goods, arranging deals, and setting the stage for market opportunities.

As an office holder, your position may grant you stewardship over a city-owned building. Keep it in good repair, commission improvements, and pay for it all from the {O_CITTRE_C}city treasury{##}. And if those repairs happen to cost a little more than expected... well, accounting is rarely an exact science.
You are always the best person to manage your own business, but once you have several buildings to look after, appointing a master can free you to spend your time elsewhere.
A master must be a member of your {CHAR_DYN_C}dynasty{##} and share the {P_C}profession{##} of the business they are meant to run.
The arrangement benefits both of you: they gain {CHAR_XP_C}experience{##} and a share of the profits, while you keep the business running without managing it personally.
Choose and train them carefully, though. A worker's {CHAR_PRO_C}productivity{##} is also influenced by the master's skill in whatever {S_C}skill{##} their current {A_ACT_C}task{##} requires.
Decreases {B_PARAM_ACCPRO_ACC}accident{##} risk whenever workers are performing tasks in this building.
Makes your business more appealing to customers, increasing {PM_ATT_C}demand{##} and driving up prices in your {B_STOFRO_C}storefront{##}.
Makes it harder for criminals to {A_ACT_STEITESTOMKT_C}shoplift{##} from or {A_ACT_ROB_C}break into{##} your business or property.
Keeps the place clean and reduces the {QUAPEREFF_ILL_C}risk of illnesses{##}.
Helps workers get more done, faster, and with better results.
Represents the building's worth, adjusted by its current {B_HP_C}condition{##}.
From hive to honey, from honey to profit.
A modest personal shrine for devotion.
Nothing says modesty like a giant stone version of yourself.
Need space? The storage shed gives you the luxury of waiting for higher prices.
A secret hub for trading forbidden goods beyond the law's reach.
With a fountain nearby, people recover energy faster — and the quarter looks more inviting.
Operating 24/7 and offering a variety of items from local and foreign merchants, there's always a great deal waiting for you in the marketplace.
A place for medical care and healing.
Dishonor here weighs heavier than chains and smells worse than rotten produce.
A secure facility for detaining those who disrupt the peace and order of the city.
The stage where officials speak and bards perform.
The center of governance, where leaders gather to discuss the city's political matters and shape its future.
Every town needs a well. Folk whisper it's also a portal — and best not to shout into it, or you may not like what shouts back.
Simple accommodations for laborers, close to their place of work and daily necessities.
A humble home providing comfort and security for its inhabitants.
A lavish residence for the wealthy, offering comfort and prestige.
A secure spot for storing goods, keeping them organized and ready for {A_ACT_CRA_C}crafting{##}.

In the storefront, items are displayed for sale, with {B_PARAM_ATT_C}Customer Appeal{##} attracting buyers during opening hours.\n\nSelling at the {B_PUB_MKT_C}Marketplace{##} usually yields higher profit, while storefront sales cut cart {B_HP_C}repair{##} costs and the {CAR_CHANATT_C}risk of waylaying{##}.
Coin earned from {B_PARAM_ATT_C}customers{##} buying directly from the business {B_STOFRO_C}storefront{##}.
Well-served customers leave in good spirits, and reward you with a little extra — a {PM_STOREV_C}coin of appreciation{##}.
The storeroom serves as a multifunctional hub for storage, storefront display, cart loading/unloading, and inventory management.
Most buildings can be upgraded up to three levels.\nEach new level unlocks additional actions, improvements, and new possibilities.
Hold Alt to temporarily highlight all buildings.
A public board for official decrees, urgent town news, and quests meant for brave or desperate citizens.
The exact location will be assigned at the start.
An old defensive tower overlooking the city, its cannon still remarkably functional despite the years.
A derelict cannon tower… There may still be a dangerous, functional cannon buried under all this rubble. Come back later in Early Access to see if anything has been uncovered.
Money held by this business, separate from your personal funds. The {B_OCC_MGR_C}Master{##} needs this fund to cover business expenses. You can deposit or withdraw money at any time.
Which expenses are paid and which earnings are deposited into the fund depend on the Master's assigned {B_MANPRI_C}responsibilities{##}.
The maximum amount of money the business can accumulate from its own operations. Money deposited directly into the Business Fund is not subject to this limit.
Take money from your purse and add it to the Business Fund. The {B_OCC_MGR_C}Master{##} will surely put it to good use. After all, you have to spend money to make money!
A little short on coin? Take some money from the business's fund and put it back where it rightfully belongs: your purse.

Set the maximum amount of money the business can accumulate from its own operations. Money deposited directly into the Business Fund is not subject to this limit. Once the limit is reached, any income is automatically transferred to your purse. If set to 0, all earnings go directly to your purse.
No carts are assigned to this building.
All money earned by the business is automatically transferred to the owner's purse. Money deposited directly into the Business Fund is not subject to this limit.
The business keeps its fund up to the set limit. Any income is automatically transferred to the owner's purse. Money deposited directly into the Business Fund is not subject to this limit.

You don't have to do everything yourself, but you don't have to give up control either. That's the beauty of being the boss! Keep the parts of the job you enjoy and leave the less appealing responsibilities to someone else.

If a {B_OCC_MGR_C}Master{##} is running your business, you might want to {A_ASSCARTOBUI_C}assign a cart{##} to the building. After all, how else will your goods reach the marketplace or your supplies be restocked?
This tab comes in handy when you have a {B_OCC_MGR_C}Master{##} running your business. Here, you can manage the funds at their disposal and decide which responsibilities to leave in their hands.
The Master is responsible for this. Change their responsibilities if you wish to handle it yourself.
Assign workers to different tasks within the building.
Construct improvements that enhance the building's capabilities.
Hire escorts to protect carts and their cargo during travel.
Hire new workers to join the building's workforce.
Control which goods are offered for sale at the building's storefront.
Make repairs to restore the building's condition.
Make repairs to restore the condition of carts.
Determine how much the building's workers are paid.
Decide how the building's workers are treated.
Purchase crafting materials for the building.
Upgrade the building to a higher level.
Money earned or spent through actions performed at this building, separate from its regular trade and business tasks.
A record of money and goods stolen from the building, whether by thieves, robbers, or other unwelcome visitors.
Money deposited into or withdrawn from the Business Fund by its owner. A generous investment today, a well-earned withdrawal tomorrow.
The costs of these activities are paid from the Business Fund.
The costs of these activities are paid from your purse.
The earnings from these activities are deposited into the Business Fund.
The earnings from these activities go directly into your purse.
